# braze_email_template (Resource)

Manage Braze Email Templates stored on the Templates & Media page. Templates created with the drag-and-drop editor are not supported.

~> Destroy removes Terraform state only; the remote object remains in Braze.
Replacement leaves the previous object behind, even if a forced `-replace` plan
does not display a warning. Import an existing object to resume management.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "braze_email_template" "example" {
  template_name  = "Example email template"
  subject        = "Welcome"
  body           = "<p>Hello {{$${first_name}}}</p>"
  plaintext_body = "Hello {{$${first_name}}}"
  preheader      = "Welcome to our newsletter"
}
```

## Template content

Braze Liquid is evaluated by Braze when rendering messages. In a Terraform
quoted string or heredoc, write `$${` to pass a literal `${` to Braze. Existing
Braze tags must be created before they are assigned through this resource.

## Optional values

Omitting optional text fields or tags sends JSON null to Braze. Empty strings and
lists are sent as explicit values. Omission may not clear an existing remote
value; review the refreshed state when removing these settings.

## Recovering from a create error

If Braze creates the object but the subsequent read fails, the provider records
the returned ID. Resolve the error and inspect both Terraform state and the remote
object before retrying. Terraform may mark it tainted and propose replacement,
which leaves the existing object behind.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body` (String) The email template body, which may include HTML.
- `subject` (String) The email template subject line.
- `template_name` (String) The name of the email template.

### Optional

- `id` (String, Deprecated) The Braze-generated ID. Use import to manage an existing object.
- `plaintext_body` (String) A plaintext version of the email template body.
- `preheader` (String) The email preheader used to generate previews in some clients.
- `should_inline_css` (Boolean) Whether Braze should inline CSS for this template. Omit on creation to use the App Group default. When omitted for an existing template, its observed value is retained. Set explicitly to manage this setting.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags that already exist in Braze. Null elements are invalid; an empty list is sent as an empty array.

## Import

Use the provider configuration for the Braze workspace that owns the object.
Choose either CLI import or an identity import block; they are alternatives.

```shell
terraform import braze_email_template.example email-template-id
```

With Terraform 1.12 or later, an identity import block can also be used:

```terraform
# Terraform 1.12 or later. Configure the provider for the owning workspace.
import {
  to = braze_email_template.example
  identity = {
    id = "email-template-id"
  }
}
```

Leave `id` out of the resource configuration; use import for existing objects.
If an existing resource configuration already sets its actual `id`, remove that
argument while keeping the resource in state.
